hired_swords.name: Dwarf Troll Slayer
hired_swords.note: Mercenaries and Witch Hunters may hire a Dwarf Troll Slayer. Warbands that include Elves may hire Slayers, but must pay 20 gold crowns after each battle instead of 10 gold crowns. Dwarfs won’t put up with weak pointy-eared folk unless they have to, or are adequately compensated for their sufferance.

hired_swords.name: Elf Ranger
hired_swords.note: Mercenaries and Witch Hunters may hire Elf Rangers. Warbands which include Dwarfs may hire Elf Rangers, but must pay 40 gold crowns after each battle instead of 20.

hired_swords.name: Freelancer
hired_swords.note: Mercenaries and Witch Hunters may hire Freelancers.

hired_swords.name: Halfling Scout
hired_swords.note: Any warband except Skaven, Undead and the Possessed may hire a Halfling Scout.

hired_swords.name: Ogre Bodyguard
hired_swords.note: Any warband except Skaven may hire an Ogre Bodyguard.

hired_swords.name: Pit Fighter
hired_swords.note: Any warband apart from Undead and Skaven may hire a Pit Fighter.

hired_swords.name: Warlock
hired_swords.note: Any warband except Witch Hunters and Sisters of Sigmar may hire a Warlock.

hired_swords.name: Arabian Merchant
hired_swords.note: Any good aligned warbands may hire an Arabian Merchant (ie, Mercenaries, Dwarfs, Witch Hunters, Tomb Raiders, etc).

hired_swords.name: Beast Hunter
hired_swords.note: Any warband other than Skaven, Beastmen, Undead, Orcs & Goblins, Possessed and Carnival of Chaos may hire a Beast Hunter.

hired_swords.name: Highwayman
hired_swords.note: Any warband, except Sisters of Sigmar, Witch Hunters and any good-aligned Elves may hire a Highwayman. A Highwayman will never join a warband that also contains a Roadwarden.

hired_swords.name: Imperial Assassin
hired_swords.note: Any warband except Witch Hunters, Sister of Sigmar, Orcs & Goblins or Skaven may hire the Assassin.

hired_swords.name: Roadwarden
hired_swords.note: Any good-aligned warband may hire a Roadwarden such as Witch Hunters, Sisters of Sigmar, Dwarfs and Human Mercenaries. A Roadwarden will never join a warband that also contains a Highwayman.

hired_swords.name: Tilean Marksman
hired_swords.note: Any warband except Skaven, Orcs or Undead may hire a Tilean Marksman.

hired_swords.name: Bard
hired_swords.note: Mercenaries, Sisters of Sigmar and Witch Hunters may hire Bards.

hired_swords.name: Big Game Hunter
hired_swords.note: The Big Game Hunter can be hired by any human Warband.

hired_swords.name: Black Orc Overseer
hired_swords.note: Any greenskin warband may hire a Black Orc Bodyguard.

hired_swords.name: Bounty Hunter
hired_swords.note: Any warband except Possessed, Undead, Skaven and Orcs may hire the Bounty Hunter.

hired_swords.name: Chameleon Skink
hired_swords.note: Lizardmen warbands only.

hired_swords.name: Clan Skryre Rat Ogre
hired_swords.note: Only Skaven warbands may hire the Clan Skryre Rat Ogre.

hired_swords.name: Dark Elf Assassin
hired_swords.note: Any evil warband may hire a Dark Elf Assassin.

hired_swords.name: Duellist
hired_swords.note: Any warband except Skaven and Undead may hire a Duelist.

hired_swords.name: Dwarf Pathfinder
hired_swords.note: Any Dwarf or Human warband (excluding followers of chaos) may hire the Dwarf Pathfinder.

hired_swords.name: Dwarf Treasure Hunter
hired_swords.note: Mercenaries and Witch Hunters may hire a Dwarf Treasure Hunter. Warbands of Dwarf Treasure Hunters are considered rivals to these individual prospectors and so may not hire them. Warbands that include Elves may hire Dwarf Treasure Hunters, but must pay double the normal upkeep after each battle. Dwarfs won’t put up with pointy-eared folk unless they have to, or are adequately compensated for their sufferance.

hired_swords.name: Elf Mage
hired_swords.note: Human Mercenaries may hire Elf Mages.

hired_swords.name: Gaoler
hired_swords.note: The Witch Hunters can hire a Gaoler.

hired_swords.name: Halfling Thief
hired_swords.note: The Halfling Thief may be hired by the following warbands: Human Mercenaries, Kislevites, and any Wood Elf, or Dwarf warband.

hired_swords.name: Human Scout
hired_swords.note: Any warband except Orcs, Goblins, Beastmen or Possessed may hire the Human Scout.

hired_swords.name: Kislev Ranger
hired_swords.note: Mercenaries, Witch Hunters and Dwarfs may hire Kislev Rangers.

hired_swords.name: Mule Skinner
hired_swords.note: Any warband, except Possessed Skaven, or any Undead warband, may hire a mule skinner.

hired_swords.name: Nomad Scout
hired_swords.note: The Nomad Guide may be hired by any warband that can afford him.

hired_swords.name: Norse Shaman
hired_swords.note: Human, Norse and Marauders of Chaos warbands may hire the Norse Shaman.

hired_swords.name: Old Prospector
hired_swords.note: Any warband may hire a Prospector ("I duzzent care if'n ye looks a mite strange... as long as yer pay in stone") except Dwarfs, who regard him as an amateur.

hired_swords.name: Pathfinder
hired_swords.note: Any warband.

hired_swords.name: Priest Of Morr
hired_swords.note: The priest of Morr is a new Hero that can be used by mercenary warbands and in doing so he replaces one of that warband's heroes. It is unlikely that Witch Hunters and Sisters of Sigmar will have a priest of Morr accompanying them, so neither of these two warbands may take one.

hired_swords.name: Runesmith Journeyman
hired_swords.note: Mercenaries and Witch Hunters may hire a Journeyman. Warbands that include Elves may hire them, but must pay 30 gold crowns after each battle instead of 15 gold crowns. Dwarfs won’t put up with weak pointy-eared folk unless they have to, or are adequately compensated for their sufferance.

hired_swords.name: Shadow Warrior
hired_swords.note: The Shadow Warrior may be hired by High Elf and all Human warbands, but may not be hired by a warband that is evil (eg Possessed) or one that includes an evil Hired Sword (eg Dark Elf Assassin).

hired_swords.name: Snake Charmer
hired_swords.note: Any good warband (human, Elf, Dwarf, etc.) may hire a Snake Charmer.

hired_swords.name: Thief
hired_swords.note: Any warband except Undead may hire a Thief.

hired_swords.name: Tomb Robber
hired_swords.note: The Tomb Robber may be hired by any good warband (human, Elf, Dwarf, etc.) that can afford him.

hired_swords.name: Warrior Priest Of Sigmar
hired_swords.note: Any warband may hire a Warrior Priest of Sigmar except Witch Hunters (they already have the warband choice!), Middenheim mercenaries, Possessed, Orcs & Goblins, Skaven and any other suitably ‘evil' warbands.

hired_swords.name: Witch
hired_swords.note: Any warband except Witch Hunters and Sisters of Sigmar.

hired_swords.name: Witch Hunter
hired_swords.note: Any non-chaos human warband may hire a Witch Hunter, he has his own reasons, but will not stay with a Witch Hunter band for more than one battle. See also the Burn the witch rule below.

hired_swords.name: Wolf Priest of Ulric
hired_swords.note: Wolf Priests may only join a Middenheim Mercenary warband and will replace one of the Champions. They see Witch Hunters and Sisters of Sigmar as heretics and worse due to the intense rivalry between the cults of Ulric and Sigmar.

hired_swords.name: Bone Goliath
hired_swords.note: Only the Restless Dead may build a Bone Goliath.

hired_swords.name: Cathayan Merchant
hired_swords.note: Any warband which includes Humans or Dwarfs may hire a Cathayan Merchant, including Battle Monks of Cathay.

hired_swords.name: Chaos Centaur
hired_swords.note: Beastmen, Marauders of Chaos, Ogres and Norse warbands may hire a Chaos Centaur.

hired_swords.name: Coachman
hired_swords.note: Any warband except Skaven, Beastmen, and Orcs & Goblins warbands may hire a Coachman.

hired_swords.name: Grave Robber
hired_swords.note: Any warband which includes a Vampire, Necromancer or Liche may hire a Grave Robber.

hired_swords.name: Hobgoblin Scout
hired_swords.note: Chaos Dwarfs and Ogre warbands may hire a Hobgoblin Scout.

hired_swords.name: Ninja
hired_swords.note: Battle Monks of Cathay and any warband except Skaven, Orcs & Goblins, Beastmen, Marauders of Chaos, Norse and Chaos Dwarfs may hire a Ninja.

hired_swords.name: Pyromaniac
hired_swords.note: Merchant Caravans, Battle Monks of Cathay and Mercenaries may hire a Pyromaniac.

hired_swords.name: Swordsmith
hired_swords.note: Merchant Caravans, Battle Monks of Cathay, Witch Hunters, Sisters of Sigmar and Mercenary warbands may hire a Swordsmith.

hired_swords.name: Beggar
hired_swords.note: Such is their desperation, a Beggar will hire itself out to any warband. Though evil warbands will have to pay 15 gold crowns for their initial hire, as the Beggar knows he may not survive the company long.

hired_swords.name: Chaos Fury
hired_swords.note:
All warbands devoted to Chaos (such as the Cult of Possessed and Beastmen Raiders) may attempt to hire a Fury once after each game by having a spell-caster in the warband attempt a summoning ritual. The Chaos Fury cannot be hired by any other means. The spell-caster must pay the hiring fee* and pass a Leadership test. These dark rituals are not without risk and on a roll of 2 or 12 the ritual automatically fails and the spell-caster is plagued by horrific visions of the Empyrean and must pass a Toughness test or miss the next game.
*The hiring fee represents the ingredients for performing the summoning ritual and are consumed regardless of the success of the ritual.

hired_swords.name: Cursed Hillman
hired_swords.note: A Cursed Hillman can be hired by the Undead, Beastmen or Possessed warbands.

hired_swords.name: Dark Mage
hired_swords.note: Human Mercs, “Good” aligned warbands. May not be hired by any Undead, Sisters of Sigmar or Witch Hunters.

hired_swords.name: Dwarf Slayer Pirate
hired_swords.note: A Dwarf Slayer Pirate may be hired by Mercenaries, Averlanders, Ostlanders, Kislevites, Witch Hunters, Tileans, Dwarf Treasure Hunters, Bandits, and Pirates. Any warband wishing to hire a Slayer Pirate that also contains an elf must pay 20gc upkeep instead of 15gc as the Dwarf will require compensation for putting up with the Elf.

hired_swords.name: Emissary of Chaos
hired_swords.note: Dark Elves, Possessed, Carnival of Chaos, Norse, and Beastmen may hire an Emissary of Chaos.

hired_swords.name: Estalian Diestro
hired_swords.note: Anyone save for Chaotic (Possessed, Carnival, Beastmen, Skaven), Undead (of any kind), Tilean or Osterlander warbands may hire the Diestro.

hired_swords.name: The Fallen Sister
hired_swords.note: Any warband except Skaven, Undead, Witch Hunters or Sisters of Sigmar may hire a Fallen Sister.

hired_swords.name: Gravesman
hired_swords.note: Anyone save for Undead (of any kind), or Carnival of Chaos warbands may hire the Gravesman.

hired_swords.name: Halfling Knight
hired_swords.note: Any good aligned warband may hire a Halfling Knight.

hired_swords.name: Imperial Tactician
hired_swords.note: Any human warband may hire an Imperial Tactician.

hired_swords.name: Knight of the White Wolf
hired_swords.note: Any Human Mercenary warband may hire a Knight of the White Wolf. However, he will never join or stay with a warband which includes a Warrior Priest, as they are an agent of an opposing cult.

hired_swords.name: Ninja Gnoblar
hired_swords.note: Except the Ogres, any warband that doesn't include any fear causing creatures may hire the Ninja Gnoblar. If the warband gains a model that causes fear, the Ninja Gnoblar will leave immediately - he may be skilled but he is still scared.

hired_swords.name: Ogre Slave Master
hired_swords.note: Possessed, Carnival of Chaos and Beastmen.

hired_swords.name: Slaver
hired_swords.note: Any evil warband may hire a Slaver.

hired_swords.name: Swashbuckler
hired_swords.note: Any non-evil warband may hire a Swashbuckler.

hired_swords.name: Ungor Trapper
hired_swords.note: Beastmen, Cult of the Possessed, Norse, Marauders of Chaos.

hired_swords.name: Weaponsmith
hired_swords.note: Any warband other than Possessed, Undead, Skaven, Carnival of Chaos, Orcs & Goblins, Beastmen, and any other “evil” warband may hire a Weaponsmith.

hired_swords.name: Wood Elf Hunter
hired_swords.note: Any good warband may hire a Wood Elf Hunter.

dramatis_personae.name: Aenur, the sword of twilight
dramatis_personae.note: Any warband except Skaven, Undead and the Possessed may hire Aenur.

dramatis_personae.name: Bertha Bestraufrung, high matriarch of the sisterhood
dramatis_personae.note: Bertha Bestraufrung will only join Sisters of Sigmar warbands.

dramatis_personae.name: Johann the knife
dramatis_personae.note: Any warband except Skaven, Undead and the Possessed may hire Johann.

dramatis_personae.name: Veskit, high executioner of clan eshin
dramatis_personae.note: Veskit may only be hired by Skaven warbands.

dramatis_personae.name: Countess Marianna Chevaux, Vampire Assassin
dramatis_personae.note: Any Warband except Witch Hunters, Sisters of Sigmar, Undead, Elves and other Sigmar devoted warbands may hire Marianna (note, mercenaries are men of lax faith and do not count here).

dramatis_personae.name: Nicodemus, the cursed pilgrim
dramatis_personae.note: Any warband except Skaven, Undead, the Possessed and Witch Hunters may hire Nicodemus.

dramatis_personae.name: Ulli & Marquand
dramatis_personae.note: Any Warband except Sisters of Sigmar and Witch Hunters may hire these rogues.

dramatis_personae.name: Abdul Alhazred, the Mad Sorcerer
dramatis_personae.note: All warbands, except Witch Hunters and Sisters of Sigmar, may hire the Mad Sorcerer.

dramatis_personae.name: Crow Master, The
dramatis_personae.note: Any warband except Dwarfs, Elves, Sisters of Sigmar and Witch Hunters may hire Simius.

dramatis_personae.name: Dark Emissary
dramatis_personae.note: Dark Emissaries are evil wizards and as such will only fight alongside Possessed, Undead, Skaven and other evilly aligned warbands.

dramatis_personae.name: Dijin Katal, The Renegade Assassin
dramatis_personae.note: Any warband except for Amazons, Shadow Warriors, Dark Elves (obviously) and any warband that includes and type of Elven hired sword may hire Dijin Katal.

dramatis_personae.name: Drenok Johansen, Wielder Of The Great Axe
dramatis_personae.note: Norse and human warbands may hire Drenok.

dramatis_personae.name: Heinrich 'Altdorf' Schmidt
dramatis_personae.note: Any Human warband may hire Altdorf Schmidt.

dramatis_personae.name: Khar-mel The Djinn
dramatis_personae.note: Any warband may hire Khar-mel. However in order to summon her, a Wizard (or other spell caster, including a Priest) must pass a test on his own Leadership. This Wizard may be a Hired Sword, but must have been with the warband for at least one battle prior to attempting to summon Khar-mel. If the Wizard that summoned Khar-mel is killed or leaves the warband, Khar-mel will leave as well.

dramatis_personae.name: Maximilian The Mad
dramatis_personae.note: Dwarfs and all human warbands except The Cult of the Possessed, Sisters of Sigmar, Carnival of Chaos, Horned Hunters and Middenheimers.

dramatis_personae.name: Penthesilea, Mark Of The Serpent
dramatis_personae.note: Penthesilea will only join Amazon Warbands.

dramatis_personae.name: Truthsayer
dramatis_personae.note: Truthsayers are benevolent wizards and as such they will only aid Sisters of Sigmar, Witch Hunters, Mercenaries and any other 'good' aligned warbands.

dramatis_personae.name: Belandysh, Condemned Champion Of Chen
dramatis_personae.note: Marauders of Chaos, Beastmen, Norse and Possessed may hire Belandysh.

dramatis_personae.name: Grand Master Ippan Shu
dramatis_personae.note: Any warband which includes Humans or Elves, including Battle Monks, may hire Ippan Shu, not including Dark Elves, Outlaws and Bandits.

dramatis_personae.name: Innominatus, the Tilean Gladiator
dramatis_personae.note: Any warband except Skaven and Dark Elves may hire Innominatus.

dramatis_personae.name: Luthor Wolfenbaum
dramatis_personae.note: Luthor offers his services in different guises, each with its own hiring restrictions.

dramatis_personae.name: Luthor the Looter
dramatis_personae.note: Luthor can be hired by any warband with no exceptions.

dramatis_personae.name: Maglah Khan's Horde
dramatis_personae.note: Orcs & Goblins, Ogres, Chaos Dwarfs, Marauders of Chaos, Norse, Beastmen, Possessed and Mercenaries may hire Maglah Khan’s Horde.

dramatis_personae.name: Aksho'akhash the Vile Dreadwing, Lord of the Carrion Throne
dramatis_personae.note: All warbands devoted to Chaos (such as the Cult of Possessed and Beastmen Raiders) may attempt to hire Aksho'akhash by having a spell-caster in the warband attempt a summoning ritual once after each game. The spell-caster must possess the Macabre Tome from the ‘Flurry of Furies’ scenario (see the previous page), pay the hiring fee*, and pass a Leadership test. If the ritual is successful, the Macabre Tome is destroyed and the Daemon is summoned.

dramatis_personae.name: “Busty” Gwen
dramatis_personae.note: See below.

dramatis_personae.name: The Dark Jester in Mordheim
dramatis_personae.note: Only Carnival of Chaos and Possessed warbands may hire the Dark Jester — anybody else just doesn’t have the right sense of humour!

dramatis_personae.name: The Headless Horseman
dramatis_personae.note: Warbands who are not of good alignment may hire the Headless Horseman.

dramatis_personae.name: The Foole
dramatis_personae.note: The Foole may only be hired by non-good warbands or Mercenaries. Witch Hunters, Sisters of Sigmar, and Bretonnians automatically hate Schleige.

dramatis_personae.name: Sigmund Spindle, the Harvester of Flesh
dramatis_personae.note: Sigmund may be hired by any evil or chaotically aligned warband.

hire_fee.note: Sigmund Sprandle may also be hired in the payment of one body part. If you wish to do this then a chosen Hero suffers one Severe Arm Wound and may only use one single handed weapon from now on.

dramatis_personae.name: William Schäke­stange, Master Bard
dramatis_personae.note: Any Mercenaries, Sisters of Sigmar and Witch Hunters may hire William. Furthermore, any good-aligned warband may hire William on a roll of 4+.
